d: Mokama MLA Anant Singh's daughter Shivangi's wedding is set to be a grand affair. A 10-bigha venue is being decorated with Taj Mahal and Red Fort-themed pandals. The celebrations will feature a grand 30-feet-high Jaimala stage, horse racing with a Thar SUV, motorcycle and scooter as prizes, multiple helipads for VIP guests and food arrangements for nearly 4 lakh people. Several prominent political leaders and celebrities have also been invited. Meanwhile, the Supreme Court has extended Anant Singh's surrender deadline to December 4, 2026, allowing him to attend his daughter's wedding.
